text: Pinehurst's nightly POS exports used to wait two days for a manual report. This video wires up the real ingestion path: an Azure Data Factory pipeline and a Snowflake Snowpipe that move data in minutes, not days.

pl_copy_pos_exports copies each store's file from the on-prem share, over a self-hosted integration runtime, into Blob storage. From there Snowpipe takes over -- no schedule, just an event the moment a file lands.
An Azure Event Grid notification, routed through a storage queue, tells Snowflake a new file exists. POS_TRANSACTIONS_PIPE picks it up and loads it into POS_TRANSACTIONS_RAW within about a minute.
Before trusting it, check SYSTEM$PIPE_STATUS and COPY_HISTORY on a real test file -- zero error rows is what actually proves the pipe is production-ready, not just created.
Transactions are now landing continuously. Next: a Snowflake Stream that tracks exactly which of those raw rows are new.
